verdict.rationale: Hightouch syncs run unattended on a schedule, on a trigger, or when data changes. Each run reports its outcome, and failure alerts can be configured, so background automations need little oversight. Automated journeys and AI Decisioning agents add autonomous campaign execution: each agent bundles an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules and guardrails, then learns and improves, and the MCP server lets users create these syncs in plain language. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how autonomously AI Decisioning agents operate day to day, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
